appearances.whereabouts: At the house of Adeleas and Vandene in Tifan's Well, Arafel; in the study and then the garden
appearances.notable_actions: Searches through books and manuscripts for answers about the Dragon, the Horn, and related matters; questions Vandene about the Prophecies, Toman Head, Shadar Logoth, and Lanfear; discusses Lan's bond and arranges for it to pass to Myrelle upon her death; is attacked by a Draghkar in the garden but saved by Lan and Jaem; concludes the Draghkar was warded by the Black Ajah; decides to leave immediately
appearances.demeanor: troubled, frustrated at not finding answers, contemplative about her long relationship with Lan, briefly jealous when thinking of Nynaeve's influence on Lan, methodical in her questioning

appearances.whereabouts: At the house of Adeleas and Vandene in Tifan's Well; initially in the barn practicing sword forms, then returning to the house, then in the garden
appearances.notable_actions: Practices sword forms with Jaem while angry; returns toward the house; saves Moiraine from the Draghkar by driving his sword through it along with Jaem; discusses the bond with Moiraine and his training of Rand; learns Moiraine has arranged for his bond to pass to Myrelle and potentially another; prepares to leave with Moiraine
appearances.demeanor: angry and off-balance during conversation with Moiraine, defensive about the bond, devoted and protective when saving her from the Draghkar, maintaining emotional walls but showing cracks
alliances_shown: the Emond's Field folk including Rand and Nynaeve

appearances.whereabouts: At her house in Tifan's Well, Arafel
appearances.notable_actions: Brings tea to Moiraine; answers Moiraine's questions about the Prophecies, the Horn of Valere, Toman Head, Shadar Logoth, and the Forsaken; advises Moiraine about Lan; responds to the Draghkar attack with a lantern; uses the One Power to restore Moiraine's strength after the attack; Heals Jaem's shoulder; agrees to send Moiraine's letters to the White Tower
appearances.demeanor: helpful, scholarly, perceptive about relationships, concerned for Moiraine's welfare

appearances.whereabouts: At her house in Tifan's Well, Arafel
appearances.notable_actions: Brings a lantern when the Draghkar is killed; examines the creature; discusses how it could have come so close without being sensed; sends Jaem to meet the villagers; agrees to hide the Draghkar and send Moiraine's letters
appearances.demeanor: scholarly, analytical, treating the Draghkar as a puzzle to solve

appearances.whereabouts: At the house in Tifan's Well; practicing in the barn, then responding to the Draghkar attack in the garden
appearances.notable_actions: Practices sword forms with Lan; helps kill the Draghkar by driving his sword through it alongside Lan; is knocked to his knees by the creature's wing; has his shoulder tended by Vandene; goes to meet the villagers and tell them nothing is wrong
appearances.demeanor: dutiful, still skilled with the sword despite his age, muttering but accepting help

appearances.whereabouts: In the garden of the house in Tifan's Well
appearances.notable_actions: Appears in the garden and attempts to use its croon to enthrall Moiraine; tries to drain her soul with its kiss; fights Lan and Jaem when they intervene; is killed by their swords driven through its breast; topples into a flower bed
appearances.demeanor: predatory, using its supernatural abilities to enthrall victims
